cqf_mechanism.description: CQF alternates between two queues per cycle. A frame arriving in cycle N is enqueued and transmitted in cycle N+1. This ensures no contention within a queue.
cqf_mechanism.queuing_delay_per_hop: One cycle duration (50 µs) as frames wait for the next cycle to be transmitted
cqf_mechanism.queue_assignment: Odd cycles use Q7, even cycles use Q6
